**Problem:** Team 400 blog claims "constrained decoding at the model level" for Agent SDK, but this contradicts the more authoritative source [10] showing tool-call emulation.

## Conclusion

The research document demonstrates **high citation accuracy** with 90.5% of claims verified against source content. The most-cited sources ([1], [2], [3], [10], [16], [17]) all grade as VERIFIED with no misrepresentations.

### Strengths
1. Accurately distinguishes between three mechanisms (Messages API constrained decoding, SDK tool-call emulation, prompt-based)
2. Correctly characterizes Agent SDK as NOT using token-level constrained decoding
3. Appropriately caveats claims (e.g., "Anthropic does not publish Claude-specific first-attempt success rates")
4. Does not propagate incorrect claims from sources (e.g., [12]'s constrained decoding claim)
5. Properly notes study limitations (e.g., arXiv paper results on open-source models only)

### Weaknesses
1. Citation [7] URL appears to map to wrong source (third-party blog vs official docs)
2. Citation [8] not fetched, preventing verification of specific performance claim
3. A few detailed claims ([22], [25]) cannot be fully verified without reading those fetched sources

### Recommendation
**APPROVED for publication** with minor note to verify Citation [7] URL and optionally re-fetch [8] to confirm the 72% → 90% improvement claim.
